breaking_news.headline: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

breaking_news.headline: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

breaking_news.headline: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
breaking_news.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
breaking_news.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

breaking_news.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

breaking_news.headline: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks — and the broader markets — got pummeled this week, raising major concerns about the financial system and the wider economy. Here's what to know.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?
breaking_news.summary: Critics say now that the AI giant is a public company, its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will be tested.

breaking_news.headline: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
breaking_news.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

breaking_news.headline: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
breaking_news.summary: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.

breaking_news.headline: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
breaking_news.summary: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

breaking_news.headline: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
breaking_news.summary: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.

breaking_news.headline: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better'
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "choice between a broken status quo or change".

breaking_news.headline: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
breaking_news.summary: Eleven people are dead in the attack on Dymer, with rescue efforts ongoing to find those still missing from the residential building.

breaking_news.headline: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
breaking_news.summary: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.

breaking_news.headline: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister of Australia, which co-hosted COP31, attributed the failure to "difficult geopolitical times".

breaking_news.headline: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
breaking_news.summary: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

breaking_news.headline: Can AI really help spot Black Friday deals? We put it to the test
breaking_news.summary: We put four AI models to the test to see if they could save us money on a new TV.

breaking_news.headline: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
breaking_news.summary: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.

breaking_news.headline: Employers are being asked to give interview feedback - here's what applicants want
breaking_news.summary: People say they often hear nothing back after applying for jobs. But could employers be forced to respond to every applicant?

breaking_news.headline: Centrica boss says he is 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
